title: Assess platform, data, and distributed-system trust boundaries: concept decisions 2
teachingQuestion: Which client, server, data, distributed, or management boundary must enforce this decision?
focalInsight: Authoritative server-side and management-plane controls must constrain every high-impact path.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Virtualization
nodes.definition: Shared infrastructure isolation delivered by a hypervisor and virtual network/storage.
nodes.detail: Shared infrastructure isolation delivered by a hypervisor and virtual network/storage.
nodes.decision: Assess guest, host, template, snapshot, virtual-switch, and console boundaries.
nodes.failureExample: A compromised hypervisor overrides expected VM isolation.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: A guest boundary is weaker than its shared host authority.

nodes.label: Least Privilege
nodes.definition: Minimal task-specific authority for users, services, and administrators.
nodes.detail: Minimal task-specific authority for users, services, and administrators.
nodes.decision: Reduce access at every client, server, database, and management boundary.
nodes.failureExample: A support account can change every production workload.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Broad authority turns one credential compromise into a systemic event.
